publication.reason: Current connector discovery exposes no GitHub push/create-tree action and no Drive upload action. Local delivery and patch only.

limitations: Three authored local routes, not free navigation or off-screen daily schedules.
Mina stands near the bench; no sitting animation.
The cabin drawing appears at arrival; no drawing animation.
No voice acting, detailed finger animation, continuous hand-to-hand transfer or ferry.
Ordinary browser suites use scripted positions, synthetic external origins, isolated MemoryStorage and software rendering.
No human full campaign, exhaustive IGN traversal, hardware performance certification or power-cut validation.
Canonical full build, CI execution and territorial regression suite must be run in the complete repository before merging.
counting_note: Repeated runs and later archive extraction checks are not additional distinct tests. The regression orchestrator exits nonzero because cold suites are blocked; it is not reported as entirely green.
